exact_reduction.target: JANUS positive signed-NAE3 row-side network with a single equality-connected orientation class
exact_reduction.side_gluing: equality chain over all row-side bits
exact_reduction.target_to_source_witness: if common side 0 return x; if common side 1 return global complement 1-x

scoped_direct_barrier.theorem: Any constant-free signed-NAE side image built with complement-preserving equality/projection is globally complement-closed.
scoped_direct_barrier.consequence: The non-self-dual direct relation {100,010,001} cannot occur as a direct exposed side image; the successful embedding is necessarily global/encoded.

active_frontier.statement: The remaining admissible JANUS side-network class already contains arbitrary Positive 1-in-3 instances. Any universal polynomial contraction of this class is itself a P=NP-level result.
